en.label: English
en.title: Give
stanzas: No one leaves merely because you say go,
do those bound to leave stay because you stop them.
Let the one who is leaving go.
place a deep kiss on their forehead.
Be a word if you must, but give silence.
Be a river if you must, but give an ocean.
Give the recipient what is theirs to receive.
the land of kia, ketaki, jai, jui and henna,
Placing their heart in the basket of your heart,
the poem you wrote upon the wind—
blow it away into the wind.
the story's lines at time's signal.
Those pairs of your feet that touched their home, doorway, courtyard,
cut them away and cast them off.
Take off all those old eyes,
to escape the noose of a relationship,
to reach, just as you were,
the place from which you set out.
Remember to give this line as a gift: “Live and let live.”
Drink your tears, suppress your sob,
give them a smile upon your lips.
To haunt them all their life,
give one last moment the colour of jamun.

hi.label: हिन्दी
hi.title: दो
stanzas: ‘जाओ’ कहने से कोई चला नहीं जाता,
रोकने से जाने वाला रुकता है।
उसके माथे पर गाढ़ा चुंबन दो।
पाने वाले को उसका प्राप्य दे दो।
लेने की बात बिल्कुल भूल जाओ।
उसके केवड़े, केतकी, जाई, जूही, हिना के देश को।
हृदय की डलिया में उसका हृदय रख,
समय के इशारे पर कहानी की पंक्तियाँ।
उसके घर, द्वार, आँगन को छूते तुम्हारे,
वे जोड़ी-जोड़ी पाँव काटकर फेंक दो।
वे सारी पुरानी आँखें उतार दो,
नई आँखों की जोड़ी पहन लो,
संबंध के फंदे से निकल आना,
फिर भी लौटा दो, लौट आओ।
उपहार में यह पंक्ति देना, याद करके: “जियो और जीने दो।”
जीवन भर यादों में घेरने को,
जामुन के रंग का अंतिम क्षण दो।

hi.title: कहाँ जाऊँ मैं
stanzas: अपने हाथों से अपने पाँव काटकर
मैं तुम्हारे आँगन में रख आई हूँ
तुम्हारी आशा सदा नदी में है
अपनी आँखों के नीले इशारे से
मैं देह की माया में छटपटाती हूँ
पर अपने होंठ छू नहीं पाती
अपनी आत्मा की सीढ़ी चढ़ नहीं पाती
आकाश तक सीढ़ी बना नहीं पाती
मैं मुट्ठी भर काँच की चूड़ियाँ हूँ
तुम पकड़ में नहीं आते, परत-परत छूते हो

पानी में पानी, हवा में हवा मिल जाए तो?
मेरे दोनों पाँव कब से तुम्हारे आँगन में हैं।।

en.label: English
en.title: Where Shall I Go
stanzas: Cutting off my own feet with my own hands,
I have left them in your courtyard.
your hope is always in the river.
I am water, mountain, flower, stone,
with the blue signal of your eyes.
I writhe in the body's illusion.
but cannot touch my own lips,
cannot climb the stairs of my soul,
cannot create the earth I desire,
cannot build a ladder to the sky.
I am a handful of glass bangles,
chiming, chiming in your name alone.
You elude my grasp, touching layer upon layer.
Thirst is never quenched within the sea.
Stealing my eyes with your eyes,
when water meets water, air meets air?
My two feet have long been in your courtyard.

en.label: English
en.title: The Faces of Disguised Crocodiles
stanzas: If eyes meet eyes, let them
if the mind flies in the wind, let it
if feet slip on the moss of age, let them
carried away in the current of a pleasure-loving river
never take the body off your body
is not a body, but a piece of fire
a moth builds a ladder to heaven
a drunken painter sits down to draw the moon
daughter! With the sparklers of your fire
there is a long queue here to celebrate Diwali
and you are forced to suffer all its aftermath
a moonless night is certain to cover the sky
beyond the burning of the body glitters
Terrifying is this lotus grove of the body
the restless earth’s jhoti patterns may be erased
there may be declared in the heart
does a flower remain a flower
when fascination with some stone crushes all its petals?
Take off the tongue, the nose, ears and mouth
take off words, take off trust...
whatever you take off, take it off; there is no ban
but you must not take off
the colourful undergarment of your momentary desire
along the riverbank of your body, seeming like love,
so many faces of crocodiles in disguise
